conventions: world SI; +y = far wall = image up in rectified frames; MEASURED = from pixels+exact frame-0 camera+Snell; MODEL-CONDITIONED = needs U=1.5cm/s, D=10mm

geometry_check_frame0.method: refracted pinhole (flat surface z=0.023, n=1.333), code/geom.py
geometry_check_frame0.needle_tips_and_cylinder_base_ring: overlay coincides by eye (<~3 px); pure pinhole would be ~19-42 px off

camera_stability.method: ECC homography, static regions (channel interior masked), half-res
camera_stability.per_frame_homography: stabilisation_H_frame0_to_n.npy / camera_stability.csv (maps frame-0 px -> frame-n px)
camera_stability.note: slow zoom-like drift, mostly after t=6 s; all rectified frames are stabilised

dye_front.status: front measured; ratio to U model-conditioned (U=1.5 cm/s)

first_rollup.side: lower, y<0 (near wall, image down-right in original view)
first_rollup.other_side: upper y>0 hooks at 0.67 s, rolls up at 0.92 s (f22)
first_rollup.note: roll-up happens at the advancing dye front ~4D downstream, both sides within 0.17 s (=0.15 AI period, not ~0.5)

vortex_size.method: blurred dye cover blob at 60% of peak; visual spirals ~20-25 mm

alternation_regularity.note: no mirror-symmetric pairs after onset (index <0.25); periods vary 0.92-1.27 s

implied_flow_if_AI_kinematics_taken_lite.note: AI wake looks like a ~3.5x time-compressed (or ~3.8x faster) flow; spatial wavelength ~physical

defects: D1 dye front advances 5.9 cm/s = 3.9U (0-1.5 s: 6.8 cm/s), 2.6x the physical maximum (1.5U); front reaches x=+0.26 m at 4.9 s vs >=12 s physically
D2 shedding frequency 0.88 Hz vs 0.27 Hz physical (3.3x); St=0.59 at the declared U
D3 vortices convect at 4.8 cm/s = 3.2U (physical ~0.85U = 1.3 cm/s) and accelerate downstream (3.6 -> 5.5 cm/s); none move upstream
D4 wake far too wide: vortex rows at y=+25/-22 mm, h=4.7D (physical ~1-2D); outer needles (+-24 mm, 2.4D off-axis) are drawn into vortices
D5 vortices too large at formation: ~2.2D (1-4.4D) spirals already 2-4D behind cylinder; intermittent third central row in far wake
D6 onset is an impulsive-start-like curl at the dye head on both sides almost simultaneously (0.75 s / 0.92 s), contradicting the long-running periodic state
D7 colour budget not conserved: magenta (3/7 of feed, 46% upstream) falls to ~5% in far wake while yellow (2/7) rises to ~58%
D8 near wake shows no dye-free recirculation bubble/stagnation split at the cylinder (streaks pass close behind it) - visual, tentative
D9 period irregular (CV 13%, 0.92-1.27 s) at Re 150 where shedding is strictly periodic

D10 camera slow zoom drift up to 3.2 px centre / 5.9 px corners at 10 s (stabilised here); cylinder/needles stay geometrically fixed (cyl top MAD 5.7/255 shading only); no flicker (bg steps <0.25/255), no duplicated frames
caveats: generated footage: numbers describe the AI clip, not reality
green front line in strip after t=4.9 s is the visibility limit, not a front
far-wake dye fades (defocus/vignette) -> blob detection weaker at x>0.2 m
